title: Operating System Concepts
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "physical" unit of information - strictly used for memory management, invisible to the user's program - and is of a fixed size, e.g 4 k bytes."
A page is a "physical" unit of information - strictly used for memory management, invisible to the user's program - and is of a fixed size, e.g 4 k bytes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for the exchange of data between an I/O module and the CPU."
An I/O buffer register (I/OBR) is used for the exchange of data between an I/O module and the CPU.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the user file directory (UFD)."
Immediately following the MFD is the user file directory (UFD).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a named collection of related information that is recorded on secondary storage."
A file is a named collection of related information that is recorded on secondary storage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high latency process, as it involves reading the contents of multiple memory locations and using them to compute the physical address."
The page walk is a high latency process, as it involves reading the contents of multiple memory locations and using them to compute the physical address.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of the course."
Tutor-Marked Assignment The TMA is a continuous assessment component of the course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of debugging a program running on a system different than the debugger."
Remote debugging is the process of debugging a program running on a system different than the debugger.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of the base address value and the length of the displacement value."
The effective physical address is the sum of the base address value and the length of the displacement value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key tool that enables the OS to support multiple processes and to provide for multiprocessing."
The PCB is the key tool that enables the OS to support multiple processes and to provide for multiprocessing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the act of debugging the core dump of process."
Post-mortem debugging is the act of debugging the core dump of process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the program status word (PSW) and the location of the next instruction to be executed, which is contained in the program counter."
The minimum information required is the program status word (PSW) and the location of the next instruction to be executed, which is contained in the program counter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the technique for managing these segments."
Segmentation is the technique for managing these segments.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as fifo with the exception that when the processor is allocated to process, the process is allowed to execute only up to a maximum length of time called the quantum."
The RR algorithm is the same as fifo with the exception that when the processor is allocated to process, the process is allowed to execute only up to a maximum length of time called the quantum.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simple memory management scheme that requires no special hardware features."
Single contiguous allocation is a simple memory management scheme that requires no special hardware features.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the concept whereby a process with a larger size than available memory can be loaded and executed by loading the process in parts."
Virtual Memory refers to the concept whereby a process with a larger size than available memory can be loaded and executed by loading the process in parts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high speed memory in the Random Access Memory (RAM)."
Cache Memory Cache Memory is a high speed memory in the Random Access Memory (RAM).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the effect of fragmentation, the development of a large number of separate free areas (ie the total free memory is fragmented into small pieces)."
A more important concern is the effect of fragmentation, the development of a large number of separate free areas (ie the total free memory is fragmented into small pieces).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to errors in a program, and the process of removing them (error correction) is called debugging."
Bugs refer to errors in a program, and the process of removing them (error correction) is called debugging.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person that submits a job or request to the computer for execution."
A user is a person that submits a job or request to the computer for execution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the software interface to system services or software libraries."
API is the software interface to system services or software libraries.

system call

A system call is a request made by any program to the kernel for performing tasks, picked from a predefined set, which the said program does not have the required permissions to execute in its own flow of execution.

LRU
LRU is an excellent algorithm, but it cannot be implemented without special hardware.

Mutual exclusion refers to the ability of multiple processes ( or threads) to share code, resources, or data in such a way that only one process has access to the shared object at a time.
______ is a single integer variable which can take non negative value and upon which two operations, called wait and signal, are defined.
semaphore
A semaphore is a single integer variable which can take non negative value and upon which two operations, called wait and signal, are defined.
______ is a difficult phenomenon to anticipate, and there are no easy general solutions to this problem.
Deadlock
Deadlock is a difficult phenomenon to anticipate, and there are no easy general solutions to this problem.
______ is a kind of stripped down process, it is just one 'active hand' in a program, something which the CPU is doing on behalf of a program, but not enough to be called a complete process.
thread
A thread is a kind of stripped down process, it is just one 'active hand' in a program, something which the CPU is doing on behalf of a program, but not enough to be called a complete process.

Thrashing

Thrashing is a degenerate case that occurs when there is insufficient memory at one level in the memory hierarchy to properly contain the working set required by the upper levels of the memory hierarchy.

operating system
The operating system is the software that controls the allocation and usage of hardware resources such as memory, CPU time, disk space, and input and output devices.
